summary: Full stack testing completed for EuroMatchTickets ticket marketplace. Fixed /api/api/ duplicate prefix bug verified as resolved. All 5 major features tested and working: F1 Tickets Page, MotoGP Tickets Page, World Cup 2026 Page, Event Details Page navigation, and Homepage featured events. 11/11 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests all passed via Playwright.

issues: Event badge shows 'Concert' instead of 'F1' or 'Motorsport' for Bahrain GP - minor cosmetic issue

critical_code_review_comments: The API URL constant at line 98 in App.js is correctly defined and all 9 frontend files properly import API from App.js
No duplicate /api/api/ prefix errors detected in console or API responses
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major ticket pages verified working. F1 page at /f1-tickets shows 23 races. MotoGP page at /motogp-tickets shows 57 races. World Cup page at /world-cup-2026 shows 20 event links with ticket categories from €149-€999. Event details page loads correctly with ticket selection, pricing, and availability indicators. The /api/api/ duplicate prefix bug has been fixed - API calls use single /api prefix correctly.
